Shared artwork illustrates the continuous-canvas idea. The real 43.2 × 57.6 mm screens and their gaps stay visible. This preview does not install firmware.

Section cut

Bright cut faces show solid plastic. Empty gaps reveal bearing clearance.

Bearings inside the end band

The external arms are gone. Short captive races fit inside a rounded end band. Small hinge edges remain visible from oblique angles; this is embedded, not a fully concealed linkage.

54 mm board pitch · 10.8 mm between active images. Thin face-frame seams keep the overall front visually unified.

The chassis prints with its hinges assembled. Three face frames print flat and snap on after the boards. Unplug USB cables before folding.

Prototype: the changed hinge layout, snap frames and board fit need a physical trial. Use the supplied print orientation.
